delta_basis: Live inherited ingress restriction was not known in earlier access comparison; project-level exception is a newly added option, so earlier comparison was incomplete.

verdict.rationale: winner not established. The load-balancer route is technically possible while retaining inherited ingress restrictions and Cloud Run IAP, but its forwarding-rule cost alone exceeds the assumed USD 10 planning target. Increased spending, TLS configuration and owner-browser acceptance remain unresolved. The project-exception rival also lacks approval and permission evidence. Neither option has COMPARATIVE evidence on P1, and owner OAuth acceptance is UNKNOWN, so neither suitability nor preference is established.
verdict.separating_test: After the user authorizes a route and its prerequisites, verify signed-out login, owner login, non-owner denial, forged-header denial, default endpoint restrictions and Gradio queue/stream behavior. Compare actual incremental cost and policy scope against the rival. Authorization and owner-browser results are required before promoting either option.
